Now, they clamor over the NVIDIA Jensen Huang departure (and possible return) to gain their political capital, just in time for it to have most mattered years ago. And, like rats from a sinking smuggling ship, Trump's cabinet members turn on each other as Jensen Huang becomes a scapegoat for some and an icon for others. In this video, we're talking about how it's really a shame that nobody warned us about all of this years ago, and that suddenly, out of nowhere and without any indication whatsoever, NVIDIA is question of antitrust concerns.
